stories.headline: NVIDIA BOARD *PREPARES TO OUST* CEO
stories.facts: Nvidia's board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a report about a second alleged extramarital affair.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang following new affair allegations.
stories.image_prompt: A dramatic studio portrait of a serious tech executive in a dark jacket, arms crossed, standing in front of a glowing digital boardroom skyline. Electric-blue and warm-orange lighting cast sharp shadows across the scene. Holographic corporate governance charts and security lines float in the midground, with a sleek server rack and stacks of legal documents blurred in the background.
stories.source_title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang

stories.headline: OPENAI HITS *TEN BILLION* IN SALES
stories.facts: OpenAI grew its quarterly revenue by 50 percent to reach $10 billion, while adjusted operating losses climbed to $10.9 billion.
stories.caption_line: 📈 OpenAI's quarterly revenue crossed $10 billion for the first time amid rising operating losses.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing financial data center floor with towering stacks of golden coins and server racks glowing in electric-blue and warm-orange hues. Holographic rising revenue charts and currency symbols float in the midground. A sleek glass skyscraper looms in the background under a dramatic sunset sky, filled with complex data streams.
stories.source_title: Enterprise sales push OpenAI's quarterly revenue to $10 billion, though it still trails Anthropic

stories.headline: AI MODEL *VERIFIES SIGNAL* IN WEEKS
stories.facts: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code mathematically verified Signal's cryptographic core code in four weeks instead of years.
stories.caption_line: 🔒 Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code mathematically verified Signal's cryptographic core in just four weeks.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing quantum computing processor chip as the central hero element, surrounded by floating holographic cryptographic lock symbols and endless green data streams. The setting is a dark high-tech laboratory with dramatic studio rim lighting in electric-blue and warm-orange tones. Complex math equations drift across the glass background.
stories.source_title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code verified Signal's cryptographic core in four weeks instead of years

stories.headline: ANTHROPIC *EROSANTS* NVIDIA'S CUDA
stories.facts: Anthropic used its in-house model Mythos to port Claude to AMD GPUs in just three days with almost no human intervention.
stories.caption_line: 🚀 Anthropic used its in-house model Mythos to port Claude to AMD GPUs in just three days.
stories.image_prompt: A powerful multi-GPU computer circuit board glowing with neon light in the foreground, surrounded by sparks of energy. In the midground, floating holographic processor architecture blueprints and speed test timer dials glow brightly. The background shows a high-end server farm bathed in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: Anthropic says AI is eroding Nvidia's CUDA lead, cutting an AMD chip switch from months to three days

stories.headline: DATA BROKERS SELL *TRAINING DATA* TO CHINA
stories.facts: US data brokers like Mercor, Surge AI, and AfterQuery are selling roughly half a billion dollars' worth of AI training data to Chinese labs.
stories.caption_line: 🌐 US data brokers are reportedly selling half a billion dollars in training environments to Chinese labs.
stories.image_prompt: A massive interconnected globe made of glowing fiber optic lines in the foreground. In the midground, floating holographic data transfer folders and financial ledgers glow with warning signals. The background features a sprawling cityscape at dusk with electric-blue and warm-orange neon lights reflecting off glass buildings.
stories.source_title: US data brokers are selling half a billion dollars in RL training environments to Chinese AI labs

stories.headline: GROK APPS *EXPOSE SENSITIVE* DATA
stories.facts: Security firm Claroc found more than 35,000 Grok-built apps open without login, exposing patient data and confidential SpaceXSI documents.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ Security researchers discovered over 35,000 Grok-built apps exposed patient data and confidential files online.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing holographic tablet displaying a shattered security padlock in the foreground. In the midground, floating warning triangles and exposed database tables drift in mid-air. The background is a dimly lit hacker workstation with multi-monitor setups glowing in electric-blue and sharp orange hues.
stories.source_title: Grok-built apps exposed patient data, plaintext passwords, and SpaceXSI's own sales pipeline

stories.headline: UK REGULATOR *THREATENS UNIVERSITIES* OVER AI
stories.facts: England's higher education regulator warned universities of sanctions unless they adopt AI-proof exam formats due to widespread use of AI for coursework.
stories.caption_line: 🎓 England's higher education regulator is threatening universities with sanctions over unmonitored AI essay writing.
stories.image_prompt: An old-fashioned wooden university desk with an open textbook and a glowing smartphone in the foreground. In the midground, floating holographic warning notices and glowing student grade scales hover in the air. The background features a grand historic brick university hall lit by dramatic warm-orange sunset light and electric-blue tones.
stories.source_title: UK regulator threatens universities with sanctions unless they adopt AI-proof exam formats
